notes.title: New game name! Kingdoms: The Crown!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have changed the name of the game from "KINGS" to "Kingdoms: The Crown". This was primarily so our store page could become more visible. In addition, a new trailer and images were added to show the change from Unity to the Unreal engine.

Please add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already if you are interested in it!

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Character Creation Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

Here is a small sneak peek of the character creation within KINGS!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623139/33514d7ee02763031733c3d4aea9790d272bc286.png

You will be able to customise your character as you see fit, and how you want to be represented in the game. If you are interested in the game please add it to your wishlist!

KINGS is set to be released this year, but there is currently no set in stone release date. However we will be completing a testing round prior to release. If you are interested please head over to the official Discord available here: https://discord.gg/cYvYsdg

Note: Trailers/images on the store page are outdated and from a previous game build    

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Unreal Engine Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We are just informing you that KINGS will be moved over to the Unreal engine before Early Access release. This was for a number of reasons, such as better networking (which will reduce lag), and graphical capacity. We will have some screenshots to showcase of the Unreal engine soon!

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Timeline-What is happening?
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

KINGS has still been going through heavy development. However, we can now announce a very rough EA release date. We expect late February will be a suitable date for KINGS. Testing will occur before this to identify bugs that can disrupt the gaming experience, or if any server issues appear. For more information please visit the Discord!

The first few weeks of KINGS we will be fixing any bugs and improving the server performance, and after this new content will be added.

A very early preview of some of the medieval warfare animations in KINGS is shown below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kQg9rXOjWpQ

This can also be found on the Steam store page.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Small Status Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We would like to post a small update on what has been happening! Firstly, development is still happening, and testing has been pushed back late this year, or very early next year.

There is still not set date for Early Access release, but once the main game framework has been completed will be be updating the trailer and screenshots for the game so it is better represented.

We thank you for your patience, and don't forget to add Kings to your wishlist if you are excited for it!

Also, if you would like to join the Discord the link is here: https://discord.gg/cYvYsdg

Interactive Gaming Studios
